meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Turn your design or text into motion video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn web designs or text into engaging videos

howto.what: 装上后，遇到视频/动画/动态图形的制作、编辑或渲染请求，它会先判断是继续已有项目还是新创作；新创作通过提问明确需求并生成需求简报，再匹配并安装对应工作流执行。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑或渲染视频/动画/动态图形（如宣传片、字幕片段、幻灯片），或要求检查、预览、发布等现有 HyperFrames 项目时触发；素材可以是网址、设计稿、音乐等。

howto.what_en: As the mandatory entry point, any request to make, edit, render, or animate a video, animation, or motion graphic is handled by resuming project state or running an interview for new work, then installing the appropriate workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered for any request to create, edit, render, or animate a video, animation, or motion graphic, or to inspect, preview, or publish/batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a URL, Figma design, footage, music, etc.

say_en.text: Add clear captions to this interview footage.
say_en.note: Routes to the caption workflow; original clip unchanged.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from this website.
say_en.note: Runs an interview, then matches product-launch workflow.

say_en.text: Check whether my HyperFrames project renders correctly.
say_en.note: Loads CLI tooling to validate the project.
